Hey! You need to drop off the spare keys to your new house tonight.
Excuse me? Why would you need keys to our private home?
Because my son lives there, and as his mother, I have every right to inspect the property whenever I please.
First of all, your son doesn't own this house. My parents bought it for me, and only my name is on the deed.
That doesn't matter! Once you marry him next month, it's half his, and you will learn to respect my authority in this family!
Well, thanks to this text, the wedding is officially cancelled. Tell your son to pack his bags by tomorrow morning.
Wait, what?! You cannot be serious! Answer the phone right now!!
Hey David, just finished the move-out inspection. I will not be returning your 2,500 dollars security deposit.
What? I hired professional cleaners and left that place spotless! Why are you withholding my deposit?
There was dust on the top of the living room baseboards, and four tiny nail holes from hanging pictures.
Greg, nail holes and light dust are defined as normal wear and tear under state civil code. You cannot deduct for that.
In my lease it says 'pristine condition'. I had to repaint the whole house. If you don't like it, take me to court.
Actually, my lawyer just sent a certified demand letter. Under state statute, bad faith deduction entitles me to 3X treble damages: 7,500 dollars. See you in small claims.
Wait wait David let's not get lawyers involved, I can Zelle you 2,000 dollars right now let's work this out!
Notice of Violation: Your electrical contractor van is parked in your driveway. That is a 500 dollars fine per day.
Brenda, I'm an independent electrician. That is my personal work vehicle and it fits completely inside my driveway.
Bylaw 14 clearly states no commercial signage visible from the street. It lowers our neighborhood property values.
I park it inside my garage every evening. It was outside for 20 minutes while I loaded tools.
Doesn't matter. I took a photo. You owe 500 dollars by Friday or we place a lien against your house.
Interesting. While you were taking photos, I noticed your backyard 2-story shed was built without city permits and exceeds height limits by 6 feet. City inspector is already en route.
YOU CALLED THE CITY ON MY SHED?! That cost me 18,000 dollars! Delete your complaint right now or I swear to God!
Need you to come into the warehouse at 6 AM tomorrow to unload 3 shipping containers.
Rick, it's 11:15 PM on Sunday. Tomorrow is my scheduled day off and I'm out of town with my family.
My nephew called in sick, so you have to step up. Being on salary means 24/7 availability.
My employment contract states 40 hours per week. I already worked 54 hours this week with zero overtime pay.
If you aren't at the loading dock at 6 AM, consider yourself terminated for gross insubordination.
Don't bother. I resign effective immediately. Oh, and I'm the only person with the password to the supplier database for tomorrow's audit. Good luck.
Marcus pick up the phone right now! You cannot do this to the company, I will give you a raise!
Hey girl! Just sent you a Venmo request for 2,000 dollars for our Bora Bora overwater bungalow!
Wait what? Why are you charging me for your honeymoon with your fiancé?
The bridal party is splitting the luxury bungalow costs. It's a tradition to gift the bride her dream honeymoon!
Ashley, I already spent 600 dollars on the bridesmaid dress, 800 dollars on your Miami bachelorette trip, and 250 dollars on hair. I cannot afford 2,000 dollars more.
If you can't afford to celebrate me, then you clearly don't value our friendship. It's my special once-in-a-lifetime day!
You're right. I'm stepping down as bridesmaid. Return my 600 dollars for the dress or keep it, but please don't contact me again.
YOU CANNOT DROP OUT 2 WEEKS BEFORE THE WEDDING! All my photos will be ruined with uneven numbers! You are so selfish!!
Dave, your 35-foot RV is parked across my driveway. I cannot get my car out to go to work.
Yeah I know, my paving guys are sealing my driveway today. Just park on the street for 3 days.
I can't get to the street! Your RV is physically blocking my garage door. You need to move it right now.
I'm already at the golf course 40 miles away. Relax, take an Uber. It's not a big deal between neighbors.
I gave you 15 minutes. Heavy duty tow truck is hooking up your RV right now. Impound lot fee is 650 dollars per day.
WHAT?! DO NOT TOUCH MY RV! It's a 150,000 dollars vehicle! Tell the driver to stop immediately!
Too late, it's turning down Maple Street. Hope your golf game went well today Dave!
Hey babe, stuck doing late paperwork at the clinic with the team. Don't wait up for me, love you ️
That's crazy, because your iMessage is synced to our living room iPad right in front of me.
What do you mean? What are you looking at?
I just watched you text Dr. Mark: 'Room 412 is booked, see you upstairs in 5 minutes handsome.'
NO NO NO that was an inside joke between coworkers! Please don't misinterpret this! Let me explain!
Save your explanations for Dr. Mark. The locksmith is replacing our front door deadbolts right now. Your clothes are in trash bags on the lawn.
TOM PLEASE DO NOT DO THIS! We have a wedding in two months! Answer my FaceTime right now!!
Hi Mrs. Henderson, thanks so much for letting your daughter Emily babysit our sleeping toddler for 2 hours tonight! I sent her 45 dollars (22 dollars.50 per hour).
Excuse me? Emily's standard rate is 150 dollars per hour. You owe an additional 255 dollars immediately.
Are you serious? Certified registered nurses don't even make 150 dollars an hour! She sat on our sofa watching Netflix for 120 minutes while our baby slept.
Emily has a 4.2 GPA and is CPR certified. Her time is extraordinarily valuable. Pay up or I will post about this on the neighborhood Facebook group.
Please go ahead and post it. The entire town will laugh you off the internet for demanding 150 dollars an hour for a 16-year-old babysitter.
You are taking advantage of a minor! I am calling my husband's attorney first thing tomorrow morning!
Good luck explaining that to the judge. Have a great night Mrs. Henderson!
Hey bro... don't freak out, but there was a minor situation with your Corvette tonight.
Tyler, you swore on your life you were only driving it 5 miles to take your anniversary date to dinner. What happened?
Road was wet and the back tires slipped a little bit into a telephone pole. Just a tiny bumper scratch.
You just texted me from a police impound lot. The officer sent me a photo. The entire front axle is snapped in half and the airbags deployed!
Well bro your insurance covers it right? That's what insurance is for, why are you screaming at me?
My insurance doesn't cover unauthorized reckless drivers doing 85 in a 35 zone with a suspended license, which the police just informed me you have.
Bro please don't press charges! I can't go to jail, I have a promotion next month! Please tell them you authorized it!
I can't believe you made a scene and kicked me out of the rehearsal dinner in front of the entire family!
Chloe, you tapped your champagne glass during my father's wedding toast and announced your 6-week pregnancy to steal the spotlight!
Everyone was gathered together! It was the perfect moment to share happy family news. Why can't you be happy for me?
You have 364 other days in the year. Tomorrow is my wedding day, which my parents paid 40,000 dollars for.
Mom agrees with me. She said you are acting like an insecure child and you need to apologize before the ceremony tomorrow.
Here is my apology: your name and your husband's name have just been removed from the reception guest list and security will escort you off the venue if you show up.
YOU BANNED ME FROM MY BROTHER'S WEDDING?! Mom is going to disown you for this! Answer your phone!
